items.stem: A drawing's title block shows the first-angle projection symbol. In first-angle projection, where is the right-side view placed relative to the front view?

options.text: To the left of the front view
options.rationale: Correct: in first-angle, views project through the object onto the far plane, so the right-side view appears on the left.

options.text: To the right of the front view
options.rationale: That placement is the third-angle convention, not first-angle.
Above the front view is where the top view sits, not the side view.
Views are drawn separately in their projected positions, never overlaid.

items.explanation: Correct: in first-angle, views project through the object onto the far plane, so the right-side view appears on the left.

items.stem: A hole is dimensioned 20.0 +0.1/-0.0 mm and the mating shaft 20.0 +0.0/-0.1 mm. Which TWO statements are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: largest hole 20.1 minus smallest shaft 19.9 gives 0.2 mm.
Correct: smallest hole 20.0 minus largest shaft 20.0 gives 0.0 mm, a line-to-line fit.

options.text: The fit can be an interference fit
options.rationale: The shaft is never larger than the hole, so interference cannot occur.
This ignores that both parts vary; the true maximum clearance is 0.2 mm.

items.explanation: Correct: largest hole 20.1 minus smallest shaft 19.9 gives 0.2 mm.

items.stem: A feature-control frame reads a position tolerance of 0.25 mm at maximum material condition (MMC). What does the MMC modifier allow?

options.text: Additional bonus tolerance as the feature departs from MMC
options.rationale: Correct: at MMC the stated zone applies, and bonus tolerance is gained as the feature's size moves toward LMC.

options.text: A tighter tolerance as the feature departs from MMC
options.rationale: The effect is the opposite: tolerance grows, it does not tighten.

options.text: That the datum may be ignored
options.rationale: Datums in the frame still apply; MMC does not remove them.

options.text: That the feature need not be inspected
options.rationale: The feature is still inspected against the position requirement.

items.explanation: Correct: at MMC the stated zone applies, and bonus tolerance is gained as the feature's size moves toward LMC.
